title: 30-Second PolyLance Overview
summary: Understand how smart contract escrows and verified Soulbound certificates protect both clients and freelancers.
transcript: PolyLance is a decentralized freelance marketplace on Polygon. When a project begins, client funds are locked securely in a non-custodial smart contract escrow. Freelancers deliver milestones with guaranteed payment protection. Once reviewed and approved, funds release instantly and a tamper-proof ERC-721 Soulbound work certificate is minted directly to the freelancer's wallet. If an issue arises, peer arbitrators on JudgeDAO resolve it transparently on-chain.

title: How to Connect Your Wallet
summary: Learn how to connect with MetaMask, Coinbase, or WalletConnect on Polygon Mainnet.
transcript: Connecting your wallet takes seconds. Select your preferred wallet, approve the connection request on Polygon Mainnet (Chain ID 137), and your profile address is instantly authenticated without usernames or passwords.

title: Posting an On-Chain Job
summary: Step-by-step guide to defining milestones, allocating budgets, and deploying escrow jobs.
transcript: To post a project, enter your scope, select required skills, and set milestone budgets in POL or USDC. Review the transparent 2.5% platform fee breakdown before publishing.

title: Applying & Negotiating Proposals
summary: How freelancers submit verified proposals and chat securely with clients.
transcript: Freelancers can review project specifications and submit tailored proposals accompanied by their on-chain SBT ratings. Clients and freelancers can then negotiate deliverable terms directly.

title: Funding Escrow & Milestone Release
summary: Understand how funds lock in the smart contract and release upon deliverable inspection.
transcript: Clients deposit milestone payments into the contract proxy. When work is submitted and approved, a single transaction releases payment directly to the freelancer's address.

title: How Disputes Are Resolved
summary: Transparent peer arbitration through JudgeDAO if deliverables do not match requirements.
transcript: In the rare event of a disagreement, either party can trigger arbitration. Selected JudgeDAO peer arbitrators inspect the milestone specs and code artifacts to cast on-chain ruling votes.

title: Reputation & Soulbound Certificates
summary: How every approved milestone mints a permanent, verifiable work credential to your wallet.
transcript: Your career history cannot be deleted or manipulated. Each completed contract mints an ERC-721 Soulbound Token with milestone metadata, star ratings, and CertifiedPass verification.

title: Verifiable First Payment Proof
summary: Inspect real smart contract settlement transactions on the Polygon blockchain.
transcript: See real on-chain transaction hashes on Polygonscan verifying that funds transfer directly between wallets without centralized custodians or withheld balances.

title: Safe by Design Security Model
summary: Non-custodial vaults, EIP-1167 proxy isolation, and automated bytecode verification.
transcript: Every escrow contract is an isolated proxy. PolyLance administrators never hold custody of user funds or private keys, ensuring maximum cryptographic security.

title: Getting Paid & Local Currency Conversion
summary: How to convert received crypto earnings to INR or USD using compliant off-ramps.
transcript: Once your escrow milestone releases in POL or USDC, withdraw directly to your bank account or exchange using standard Polygon-compatible gateways.
